text:
maya: Quick sanity check — finalizing Team-X model onboarding (mistral-v1 variant). config.json linted locally but gate failed in CI with a tokenizer/weights mismatch. weight URI: gs://redwood-models/team-x/mistral-v1/weights.tar.gz. Anyone seen subtoken shift with this tokenizer?

arjun: pinging — I remember this dataset had an alternate BPE table. Did the ingest convert to our canonical vocab?

maya: Not sure, the manifest points at a tokenizer blob named tokenizer_v2.json inside the tar. CI error shows: 
```
ERROR: tokenizer.offset mismatch (config: 2, weights: 3)
expected pad_id=0, but got pad_id=1 in weights
```

jen: @maya can you paste the config snippet? sometimes the field is `special_tokens` vs `offsets` depending on exporter.

maya: sure:
```json
{
  "tokenizer": {
    "type": "bpe",
    "vocab_size": 50288,
    "offset": 2,
    "pad_token": "<pad>"
  },
  "weights_uri": "gs://redwood-models/team-x/mistral-v1/weights.tar.gz"
}
```

ryan: I pulled the tar earlier — the tokenizer metadata inside has `offset: 3` and `pad: 1`. Looks like exporter used legacy offsets. Quick fix is to set `tokenizer.offset_override: 3` in config on onboarding patch, but we should avoid silencing real mismatches.

lia: can we add a schema lint rule that compares `tokenizer.offset` against the parsed tokenizer file during CI? That would catch this earlier.

onboard-bot: schema-lint: running checks on manifest -> FAIL (tokenizer.offset != weights.offset). See /ci/logs/1758504321/ for details.

maya: thanks all. Plan: I'll push a small PR to onboarding manifest that sets `tokenizer.offset_override` with a comment linking to the weight tar and file path. @arjun @jen can you review? Also adding a quick schema check ticket.

arjun: ack, will review in a bit. Also add a smoke test that runs a short prefix through runtime to verify tokenization parity.

jen: small note — if we add override we should also include a one-line eval to ensure generation isn't degraded (e.g., prompt "Hello" -> tokens). saves back-and-forth later.

maya: will do both (override + smoke gen). Filing ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ML-1289 — schema-lint: compare tokenizer metadata vs weights during ingest.

ryan: FYI I added a short README inside the weight tar listing original exporter and date; putting it back in the manifest helps future debugging.

maya: awesome. I'll mark onboarding PR as WIP and drop links here once ready. Thanks :thumbsup:

onboard-bot: ticket ML-1289 created and linked to onboarding PR when available.
